content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines returning json from django as part of building apis with django. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.

content_blocks.title: What to cover
content_blocks.text: The source syllabus for this lesson names: JsonResponse; JSON serialization; Handling supported data types; Content types and status codes; Designing predictable error responses. Keep these distinct concepts together: know what each item does, when it applies, and what assumption must be verified in your project.
